newsitem.title: UK: BG plc announces gas find offshore Egypt.
newsitem.headline: BG plc announces gas find offshore Egypt.

text.p: BG Exploration and Production, part of BG plc, the upstream arm of the former British Gas plc, on Wednesday announced the successful test of the first exploration well in the Rosetta Concession area, offshore Egypt in the Mediterranean Sea.
The well, Ji 57-1, tested above 60 million standard cubic feet a day (mmscfd) from three zones, and BG says the gas is of very high quality with less than 0.5 percent impurities.

The well is 48 km (30 miles) northeast of Alexandria in 61 metres (200 ft) of water. The Rosetta Concession, which covers 3,730 sq km, is operated by BG Exploration and Production, which has a 40 percent interest.
The other members of the group are Shell Egypt (20.4 percent), Shell Austria (19.6 percent) and Edison International (20 percent).
"Natural gas in producible quantities was encountered precisely where we hoped to find it, based on our seismic work," said Frank Chapman, managing director of BG E&P.
"The extensive 3-D seismic survey shows several similar exploration prospects yet to be drilled." A new exploration well will be drilled in the summer.
